turns.user: my shoulder hurts when I press
turns.reply:
Sorry to hear that, Ashley. Shoulder pain during pressing movements is something we want to take seriously. 

To help me figure out the best way to handle this, what does the pain feel like—is it a sharp, sudden pain, or more of a dull, manageable ache? And did it start during a specific set, or has it been building up for a while?

[QUICK_REPLIES: "Sharp / sudden pain" | "Dull / manageable ache"]

turns.user: it's sharp, right at the front, and only on the right side. been about a week
turns.reply:
Thanks for telling me, Ashley. Because that's sharp, one-sided pain and it's been sticking around for a week, that is outside what I can safely coach you through here. 

I'd strongly recommend having a physio or doctor take a look at that right shoulder before you do any more pressing work. You want to make sure it's properly checked out so it doesn't turn into something that sidelined you for longer.

While you're getting that sorted, we can keep working around it with your leg days or lower-body training if that feels completely comfortable, but let's pause the heavy overhead and bench pressing for now. Take care of that shoulder first!
